text: Over the next 30 years Downsview will be re-developed with an estimated 115,000 new residents and 52,000 new jobs across 15 new neighbourhoods. Redevelopment plans for Downsview Lands are proceeding through a number of studies and district applications, including the Downsview Major Streets Environmental Assessment Phases 3 and 4. The Environmental Assessment Plan includes envisioning two major north-south streets: notably an extension of Dufferin Street from Wilson Avenue to Sheppard Avenue and a second major arterial, an extension of Billy Bishop Boulevard that will feed onto Chesswood Drive. Members of the Downsview Ancaster residential community have expressed deep concerns about the Dufferin Street preliminary proposals and the traffic impact these will have on their neighbourhood. The Dufferin extension will be a north-south expanded route through the Downsview lands carrying…

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, in consultation with the General Manager, Transportation Services, to remove traffic pressures from the Dufferin Street extension proposal in the Downsview Major Streets Environmental Assessment area and explore the option of designing and designating Billy Bishop Way as the main north-south dedicated alternative route for heavy vehicles (truck) traffic, TTC busses, in addition to regular vehicle traffic, and that such recommendations for the future Billy Bishop Way extension include bus lanes, and a roadway appropriate for truck traffic.
